description: Monica and Chandler plan their wedding while Rachel's career and relationships change, Joey and Ross deepen their odd-couple friendship and the season builds toward the wedding and the revelation that someone in the group is pregnant.

s07e01.description: Monica is furious when Rachel and Ross's kiss steals attention from her engagement night, while Chandler struggles with the realization that his life is genuinely changing.

s07e02.description: Joey discovers Rachel's erotic novel and will not stop teasing her, while Monica learns her parents spent the money they had promised for her wedding.

s07e03.description: Monica desperately tries to recreate Phoebe's late grandmother's secret cookie recipe, while Chandler attempts to bond with Monica's father and Rachel teaches Joey to sail.

s07e04.description: Rachel hires handsome Tag as her assistant despite a more qualified candidate, while Joey, Chandler and Monica argue over who gets to keep an expensive new chair.

s07e05.description: Monica struggles to get Chandler to smile naturally for their engagement photograph, while Joey teaches Tag how to attract women and Phoebe dates a man after a strange encounter.

s07e06.description: Joey and Ross discover they enjoy napping together but are horrified by what the others might think, while Monica tries to decide who should be her maid of honor.

s07e07.description: Ross is delighted that his dissertation is in the university library until he discovers students use the quiet aisle for sex, while Monica runs into an old boyfriend.

s07e08.description: The group discovers Chandler dislikes dogs after Phoebe secretly keeps one in the apartment, while Ross refuses to name all fifty states and Thanksgiving becomes a trivia ordeal.

s07e09.description: Monica's homemade candy makes her wildly popular with neighbors until demand gets out of control, while Phoebe learns to ride a bicycle and Rachel evaluates Tag.

s07e10.description: Ross invents the Holiday Armadillo to teach Ben about Hanukkah, but Chandler's Santa costume and Joey's Superman arrival turn the lesson into chaos.

s07e11.description: Rachel and Chandler become addicted to cheesecakes repeatedly delivered to the wrong apartment, while Phoebe is hurt when Joey cancels dinner for a date.

s07e12.description: A rooftop comet watch leaves everyone awake for separate reasons, including Ross and Joey trapped on the roof, Monica unable to sleep and Rachel arguing with Tag.

s07e13.description: Joey's beloved recliner breaks and he struggles to replace it, while Rachel and Chandler discover they both believe the other broke it and Phoebe takes a telemarketing job.

s07e14.description: Rachel's thirtieth birthday prompts flashbacks to each friend's own crisis at turning thirty and forces her to reconsider her relationship with Tag.

s07e15.description: Joey's soap-opera character receives the brain of a female character, while Ross prepares a disastrous musical surprise for Monica and Chandler's wedding.

s07e16.description: Chandler learns that Monica originally intended to sleep with Joey on the night their relationship began in London, while Phoebe develops a headache after finding a positive pregnancy test.

s07e17.description: Monica fights another bride over a bargain designer wedding dress, while Joey and Ross compete for the attention of the same woman.

s07e18.description: Joey is nominated for a soap-opera award and refuses to accept losing gracefully, while Monica realizes how little time remains before marriage.

s07e19.description: Ross becomes embarrassingly attracted to his visiting cousin, while Phoebe and Rachel plan Monica's bridal shower and Joey auditions for a role requiring extreme physicality.

s07e20.description: Rachel encounters former college friend Melissa and tries to prove to Phoebe that the two once kissed, while Chandler and Ross compete over tuxedos worn by celebrities.

s07e21.description: Monica and Chandler struggle to write meaningful wedding vows and remember the long chain of events that brought them together.

s07e22.description: Monica persuades Chandler to invite his estranged father to the wedding, while Rachel gets into trouble using Monica's Porsche.

s07e23-24.description: Wedding preparations unravel when Chandler panics and disappears, forcing Ross and Phoebe to search for him while Monica remains unaware. Chandler returns and marries Monica, while the group initially mistakes Rachel's positive pregnancy test for Monica's and Joey races from a film set to officiate.
